description:
• Brand introduction: From one parent to the next, Pijeme was founded with the whole family in mind. We designed a curated assortment of top-drawer basics for your baby, creating minimalist, quality staples that will get you through those first years in timeless style, all the comfort, and none of the fuss. 

• Product description: 100% GOTS organic cotton essentials for the babies in your life, in neutral colors that will flow with your family's lifestyle. 

• USP (Unique Selling Point): 100% GOTS organic cotton, versatile + timeless colors, designed by a parent for parents, snaps for easy changes, styles that seamlessly transition from naptime to playtime and back.

• Payment terms: Net 15 of affiliate sale

• Other information: Shipping in Canada only currently, US and Rest of World coming soon

This Affiliate Marketing Agreement ("Agreement") is made between Pijeme ("Merchant") and the "Affiliate".  The purpose of this Agreement is to outline the terms and conditions under which the Affiliate will promote and advertise the Merchant's products or services.
